text_blocks.text: Slowing down Saddiq Bey or Jeremiah Fears has to be mission number one in the second half because the big-time bifocals, Saddiq Bey was seven of eight with 21 points.

text_blocks.speaker: Kelenna Azubuike
text_blocks.text: He did it in a lot of different ways. First of all, he didn't miss a three, so that helped the Pelicans for sure. But he got it from the outside, he went inside, he actually got some work from the mid-post. It was just catch and shoot. First of all, you got to be up to touch with this guy if he's this scorching hot. Push up into him, make him do something else other than shoot three, make him drive by you, help your teammates out if you need it, but man, you got to stop him somehow.

quotes.social_post: Saddiq Bey is scorching hot with 21 points in the first half. Bob Fitzgerald says the Warriors need to make him do something else other than shoot three and push up into him to stop the Pelicans momentum in the second half.
